plan: A bunny mage who jumps between worlds to turn invisible and trap her enemies.
aSurveiller: Her R (Between Worlds). She creates a zone that slows, in which she teleports from one edge to the other: get out of it fast.
contrer: Get out of her R zone: inside, you are slowed and she teleports around you.
After her W she turns invisible: keep an area spell or a ward.
Engage her once her E and W are used: she has no escape left.

sorts.P: Spirits of wounded enemies follow her and heal her.
sorts.Q: Projectile that curses; she can recall it.
sorts.W: Leaps and turns invisible for a moment.
sorts.E: Ball that slows, then she hops backwards.
sorts.R: Zone that slows, in which she teleports.

momentFort: Strong early, and dangerous from level 6.
